text:
alex: Quick PSA — noticed a couple of runtime guide links 404ing when running local smoke tests. Example that failed for me: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/v2/kvcache -> 404. Anyone own the runtime guide v2 pages? Thinking small fix: either a tiny PR to update paths in examples or add a redirect.

maya: I can take a peek. Which file / path did you hit?

alex: Top-level page, under 'Configuring KV cache' — examples show /runtime/v2/kvcache (no hyphen). Saved the failing curl output here: https://gist.github.com/alex/def456 (curl shows 404).

ben: ran `rg "kvcache" docs/ -n` and found 3 hits: `docs/runtime/v2/index.md` (example block), `docs/examples/cache-demo.md`, and `runbooks/kv-troubleshooting.md`.

alex: thanks — I can do a minimal PR for the examples, but redirect is probably safest for user-facing links.

doc-bot: link-scan: /runtime/v2/kvcache flagged as dead link on 2026-03-22, previous assignee: unknown.

maya: +1 on redirect. We have a helper `scripts/add-redirect.sh` that adds entries to the redirect table. If infra is OK, add `/runtime/v2/kvcache -> /runtime/v2/kv-cache` and then we can follow with docs edits.

ben: i'll open a WIP PR with two commits: (1) add redirect via `scripts/add-redirect.sh` and (2) harmonize examples to use `/runtime/v2/kv-cache`. Drafting now, will tag @maya for review. Example patch snippet I'm using: ```bash
# add redirect
./scripts/add-redirect.sh "/runtime/v2/kvcache" "/runtime/v2/kv-cache" "tiny: normalize path"
# fix examples
rg -l "kvcache" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's|/runtime/v2/kvcache|/runtime/v2/kv-cache|g'
```

maya: perfect. For rolls: please include a short migration note in `runbooks/kv-troubleshooting.md` and mark the redirect with a 7-day TTL before pruning the old path.

lina: noted — please schedule the redirect in the 48h maintenance window so SRE is aware. If anything flakes, we can revert quickly. Also add a changelog entry in the docs release notes.

ben: will target the maintenance window and add changelog + runbook note. PR will be WIP and I'll post link here when ready for review.

alex: awesome, thanks y'all :rocket:

maya: thanks @ben — ping when the PR is ready and i'll do a quick pass for wording and codeblocks.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP). Tagged reviewers: @maya, @lina.

alex: thanks — once redirect lands, i can re-run smoke tests and confirm the 404s are gone.

lina: thumbs up. keep me posted if we need to coordinate rollback.
